verses.text: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me, because the LORD has anointed me to bring good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to announce freedom to the captives, and to set the prisoners free,
to announce the year of the LORD's favor and the day when our God will pay back his enemies, to comfort all who mourn,

and to provide for those who grieve in Zion. He will give them a crown of beauty instead of ashes, the oil of joy instead of mourning, and clothes of praise instead of a spirit of despair. They will be called oaks of righteousness, planted by the LORD to show his glory.
They will rebuild the ancient ruins and restore the places that were destroyed long ago. They will repair the ruined cities that have been empty for many generations.
Strangers will come and take care of your flocks. Foreigners will work in your fields and vineyards.
But you will be called priests of the LORD. People will call you servants of our God. You will enjoy the wealth of the nations and boast in their riches.

Instead of shame, my people will receive a double portion. Instead of disgrace, they will celebrate their inheritance. So they will receive a double share in their land, and everlasting joy will be theirs.
"For I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and wrongdoing. I will faithfully reward my people and make an everlasting covenant with them.
Their descendants will be known among the nations, and their children among the peoples. All who see them will recognize that they are a people the LORD has blessed."

I am overjoyed in the LORD! My whole being celebrates in my God. For he has dressed me in clothes of salvation and wrapped me in a robe of righteousness, like a bridegroom wearing a priest's headdress, like a bride decorated with her jewels.
For as the soil makes the young plant come up, and a garden makes its seeds grow, so the Lord GOD will make righteousness and praise spring up before all the nations.
